title: A Juventude
desc: In a gloomy room, back in the 1960s in Portugal, a 16-year-old girl lives with a one-year-old baby: her son, the reason for her confinement.

title: A Trégua
desc: Spanish teacher Angelica struggles to adapt to the routine imposed by the Covid-19 pandemic. During the interval between classes, a set of concerns is revealed: adequacy of classes to the virtual environment, insecurity about staying in the job, the current political scenario, in addition to the pressures related to their physical and mental well-being. Over five dense minutes, accompanying the teacher, it is possible to see her interacting with friends on social networks, in order to be distracted, before starting the new class. But not all nights are being equal...

title: Macacos
desc: Vinícius, a young surfer from Rio, falls in love with Paigô, an Indigenous woman, after seeing her in a viral video shot in the Tatuyo’s village. Determined to pursue this romance, he travels to the village, where he must overcome the challenges of adapting to a new environment, cultural differences and survival tests imposed by his beloved’s family.

title: O Vizinho
desc: Paulo começa a desconfiar de seu novo vizinho, Kieran McCallister, um homem misterioso e extremamente antissocial. Após presenciar acontecimentos cada vez mais estranhos, Paulo passa a acreditar que Kieran esconde um terrível segredo — e decide investigar por conta própria. Mas, quanto mais tenta descobrir a verdade, mais Paulo percebe que talvez o maior perigo seja tirar conclusões precipitadas.
